name: revAcc_nil
prelude:
def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]

def revAcc : List α → List α → List α
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => revAcc xs (x :: acc)
statement: theorem revAcc_nil (xs : List α) : revAcc xs [] = myRev xs
proofs:
have h : ∀ acc : List α, revAcc xs acc = myRev xs ++ acc := by
    induction xs with
    | nil => intro acc; rfl
    | cons x xs ih => intro acc; simp [revAcc, myRev, ih]
  simpa using h []
  have h : ∀ ys acc : List α, revAcc ys acc = myRev ys ++ acc := by
    intro ys acc
    induction ys generalizing acc with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons y ys ih => rw [revAcc, ih, myRev, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
  rw [h, List.append_nil]
